(tha)༄༅/ /sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga dge tshogs rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /gang phyir gus pa re yang lhur blangs pas/ /dpag ya

tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga dge tshogs rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// gang phyir gus pa re yang lhur blangs pas// dpag yas bsod nams chu gter 'phel byed pa// yon tan bsam mi khyab bdag dkon mchog gsum// skyabs su bsten no byang chub bar du skyongs// ring nas bsags pa'i sdig pa sbyang phyir dang*// tshad du bcal dka'i tshogs rab rdzogs bya'i phyir// sāts+tsha'i rnal 'byor nyams su bstar ba'i tshul// mdo rgyud mkhas pa'i gzhung don gsal bar phye// nyes skyon gzhom pa'i g.yul ngor mi spro zhing*// phan pa'i snying gros lkog tu 'doms min yang*// tshul 'dir 'bad pas mngon mtho nges legs kyi// dpal kun lag rtser sbyin la 'di rmad byung*// de'ang gnas skabs gang yang rung bar phan yon gzhal du med pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sam/ sāts+tsha bskrun pa la sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni sa gsar du blang dgos na/ gnas der gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin la sa bslang*/ oṃ badz+ra kha na kha na hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ rin chen sna bdun gyi sa gzhir bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ā ko ṭā ya hūm̐ zhes brjod kyin brko ste sa blangs zin pa la mi dgos so// gnyis pa ni sa des 'jim pa brdzis te brdung ba na/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas rang gang mos pa'i lhar gsal bas 'jim pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes pas 'jim pa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i phung por gyur/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung*/ 'jim pa la thim pas 'jim pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can du gyur par bsam zhing*/

lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung bkug pa mthe bos mnan pa gan rkyal du bzhag pa'i steng g.yas pa'ang de bzhin du byas pa kha bub tu bzhag la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bai ro tsa na pra bhā rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā/ 'di lta ste/ oṃ sūk+ṣ+me sūk+ṣ+me/ rdul phran rdul phran/ sa me sa ma ya/ mnyam pa'i dam tshig ma/ shān+te dān+te/ zhi ma dul ma/ a sa mā ro bre/ mnyam med rang bzhin ma/ a na lam+bhe/ dmigs pa med ma/ ta ram+bhe/ sgrol ma/ ya sho wa tī/ snyan grags ldan ma/ ma hā te dza/ gzi brjid chen po/ ni r ku le/ rigs thal ma/ nir wa ṇe/ mya ngan las 'das ma/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs kyi byin gyis brlabs ma/ zhes rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i gzungs 'di lan nyer gcig bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ 'jim pa bcad pa'i tshe/ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ kun nas sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ rdo rje'i tshe ru gzhi tshugs/ zhes brjod pas chos kyi skur grub par bsam/ 'bi 'bi bya ba'i tshe/ oṃ badz+ro d+bha wā ya swā hā/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i ched du gzhi tshugs/ zhes brjod cing ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rgyas par bsam/ snum 'byug pa dang 'og tu sa dkar 'byug pa na/ oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze swā hā/ rdul med rdul bral ma/ zhes brjod cing byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang pos bsgos par bsam/ 'bi 'bi rgyar gzhug pa na/ oṃ dhar+m+ma dhā tu gar+bhe swā hā/ chos kyi ring bsrel snying po ma/ zhes brjod cing thabs dang shes rab zung du chud par bsam/ brdung ba'i tshe/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ā koṭ+ṭā ya hūm̐/ rdo rje tho bas rdungs shig rdungs shig zhes dang*/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa datra/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ

zhes rten 'brel snying po brjod cing ye shes chen po'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ de nas nang gi gzungs rigs lnga'i sa bon dang rten 'brel snying po/ gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs rnams bris pa'am/ med na 'bru'i me tog oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā/ thams cad rig ma/ zhes brjod cing nang du dbul/ rgya nas 'don pa na/ oṃ dhar+m+ma ra te swā hā/ chos kyi dga' ba ma/ zhes brjod cing rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bsams te/ de yan gyis longs skur grub par bsam/ gdan la bzhugs su gsol ba na/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ legs par rab gnas rdo rje ma/ zhes brjod cing sprul skur grub par bsams te/ de ltar gzugs sku gnyis kyis sems can gyi don mdzad par bsams la/ gong gi sngags dang bcas pas sa dkar gsol/ de nas me tog thogs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi sha ta dīp+te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nor bu brgya phrag mar me ma/ dz+wa la dz+wa la dhar+m+ma dhā tu gar+bhe swā hā/ 'bar ba 'bar ba chos kyi ring bsrel snying po ma/ zhes dang rten 'brel snying po brjod cing me tog 'thor ba ni rab gnas bsdus par 'gyur zhing*/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog /ces pas dge ba bsngo ba ste/ de dag ni sāts+tsha'i cho ga rgyas par bya ba'i tshul lo// yang na 'jim pa swa bhā was sbyang ba nas/ rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i sngags nyer gcig bzlas pa'i bar sngar bzhin byas la/ 'debs pa'i tshe rten 'brel snying po kho na zlo zhing btab pas sāts+tsha sku gsum gyi ngo bor grub par bsams la/ rab tu gnas pa'i sngags rnams brjod de/ dge ba bsngo ba gong ltar bya ba ni 'bring du bya ba'i tshul lo// yang na 'jim pa'i gong bu la rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i gzungs ci nus bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te rten 'brel snying po zlo zhing btab la/

rab gnas kyang sngags de nyid kyis me tog 'bul ba dang dge ba bsngo ba ni bsdus par bya ba'i tshul lo// gshin don du rus bu la sogs pa las sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga ni kun rig gi rtsa rig 'don pa sogs gzhan du gsal bas 'dir ma bris so// de ltar cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung gis sāts+tsha rgyun khyer lta bur byed pa'i tshe/ yul mchog dman gyi ched du dmigs pa'i bsngo ba smon lam bya ba'am/ 'dod don gsol gdab dang 'brel bar nyams su bstar ba'i dbang du byed na/ sāts+tsha tshar lnga btab pa'i dang po'i dge ba bsngos pa'i rjes thog de ma thag par/ 'di skad du/ sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin gyis gtibs// lung rtogs bstan pa dri med phyogs bcur rgyas// bshad dang sgrub pa lhur len 'dus pa'i tshogs// nor 'dzin dkyil 'khor yongs khyab rgyas par shog /ces brjod/ gnyis pa'i rjes su/ dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma gang byon pa'i// zab yangs thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*// da ltar bzhugs rnams sku tshe ring 'tsho zhing*// phrin las 'gro don phyogs bral rgyas par shog /ces dang*/ gsum pa'i rjes su/ bdag kyang skye ba 'di dang yang srid rnams// dkon mchog skyabs bzung tshe dpal 'byor pa 'phel// tshogs zung rgya mtsho'i pha rol legs brgal te// yon tan rin chen gter la dbang 'byor shog /ces dang*/ bzhi pa'i rjes su/ skyed byed drin du che ba pha mas mtshon// mar gyur rigs drug sems can srid do cog /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'ching ba yongs grol nas// thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong mchog phyin par shog /ces dang*/ lnga pa'i rjes su/ dus byas ring po ma yin mi phyugs kyis// nyer mtshon srid pa bar do'i sems can rnams// 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal kun bral bar// dkon mchog byin rlabs rdzogs 'tshang rgya bar shog /ces brjod/ 'dod gsol byed na shog ces pa'i tshab tu/

mdzod ces pa'i skul tshig bsgyur bas grub bo// gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu spro ba'am sāts+tsha mang po dus gcig tu bsags la rab gnas 'bring po tsam byed na/ rang thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ bsgrubs pa'i bum chu'am rten rnying pa la sku khrus gsol ba'i khrus chu yod pa'am med na yid kyis bsams la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shri ye hūm̐ gi bar gyis khrus gsol/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sāts+tsha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i seng ge'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur gyur/ de zhu ba las chos sku'i mchod rten mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum pa'i nang du dbus su seng ge shar du glang chen/ lhor rta/ nub tu rma bya/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ shar du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ lhor trām̐ las rin po che trām̐ gis mtshan pa las rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin dang mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ nub tu hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ byang du aḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje aḥs mtshan pa las don grub ljang gu skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur ces dang*/ sku brnyan yod na/ stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bskyed do// de nas de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes mang du brjod pas bstim/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad sogs kyis bstod/ mig thur ram rdo rje rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas bzung nas spyan dbye ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ne swā hā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa thob ste sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod/

ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed cing bstims pa'i lha de rnams 'od du zhu ba las/ rten so so'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ 'bru gtsang ma'i me tog ye dharmā'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du yang rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā zhes dang*/ ye dharmā lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ slar yang mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ phun sum tshogs pa'am/ che ba'i che mchog sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs pa brjod cing me tog gi char phab ste/ rten rnams skye bos mi 'gom pa'i phyogs su bzhugs su gsol lo// gsum pa ni/ spyir mchod rten zhes pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten gsum spyi la 'jug mod/ 'dir mchod rten dang sku gzugs so sor smos te bzhengs pa'i phan yon gsal rgyal gyis zhus par/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni// gzugs sku rnams la rdul phran ci song ba// de yi grangs snyed de byed mi rnams kyis// lha yul sa steng nges par rgyal srid 'thob// gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting nge 'dzin// phun sum tshogs pa'i sa mchog kun myangs nas// tha mar skye dang rga la sogs pa yi// sdug bsngal med par sangs rgyas go 'phang thob// ces sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhag pa'i phan yon brjod par/

gzugs brnyan byed pa'i gang zag sbyin pa po la phan yon gzhal med khang chen por gnas pa sogs dang*/ phyug cing nor mang ba sogs dang*/ gzugs bzang zhing lta na sdug pa sogs dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor bzang po rin po che sna bdun dang ldan pa sogs dang*/ lus dang bral ma thag bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten lhar skyes nas der lha'i gnas bcu la longs spyod pa la sogs pa'i phan yon lnga gsungs/ 'phags pa rmad du byung ba las kyang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling nas brtsams te stong gsum 'jig rten khams kyi bar rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin du byas te/ rgyun du zhugs pa rnams dang*/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams dang*/ phyir mi 'ong ba rnams dang*/ dgra bcom pa rnams dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul ba bas/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod rten 'jim pa las skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu tsam byas pa'i bsod nams ches che bar bsngags pa sogs gsung rab rnams las rgya cher 'byung zhing*/ gong gi rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i gzungs bzlas te mchod rten byas pa'i phan yon ni/ gzungs de nyid las/ gzungs 'di 'jim pa'am bye ma'i gong bu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la mchod rten bya'o// mchod rten de la rdul phra rab kyi grangs ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi mchod rten byas par 'gyur ro// rdul phra rab kyi grangs ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi lha dang mi rnams kyi skye ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro// gang dang gang du skyes pa na skye ba dran par 'gyur ro// myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ de bzhin du rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa'am nang du bcug pa'i phan yon sogs mang du 'byung ba rnams shes par byas nas tshul 'di la shin tu 'bad par rigs so// smras pa/

thub gsung rig byed 'byin po'i bka' yis stsal// dgongs 'grel bde 'byung ral pa'i khrod du gnas// dam pa'i gzugs brnyan sgrub thabs mtho ris klung*// thos brtson skal ldan shing rtas 'di na drangs// tshegs chung phan yon che ba mang bsnyad kyang*// bde gshegs gzugs brnyan bskrun pa'i do zla su// yid 'phrog me tog grangs med bzhad pa'i dbus// u dum wā ra gnyis pa cang mchis sam// tshul 'di bsdebs pa'i g.yar dam yi ge dag /snying la bkod pa gang tshe sa skyong gi// gsung bskul snyan dngags lhang lhang 'jebs pa'i tshe// sug pa'i yal 'dab zlos bu'i gar gyis rtsen// dge tshogs stobs su rdzogs pa'i ru sbal gyis// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho la zhugs rnam pa kun// mkhyen pa'i kun bzod dkyil 'khor legs phyung nas// lus can bde bar ngal gso'i rten gyur cig/ //ces sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga dge tshogs rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sgang 'gram sa 'dzin blo bzang byams pa zhes pa'i gsung mchid kyis bskul ngor/ dri ma med pa'i bka' dang*/ jo bo a ti sha la sogs pa 'phags bod kyi dran dbang mang po'i dgongs 'grel las ji ltar 'byung ba nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas dpal gdong zhes pa gsar tshes kyi bgrang gzhi'i chu zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa/ sgra mkhan rgyal sar phebs pa'i nyin grub par bgyis pa sems can thams cad la phan par gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
